checks.name: python_syntax
checks.command:
bin/mesh-python - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
paths = sorted(Path('xonotic/solver').rglob('*.py')) + sorted(Path('xonotic/payload/tools').glob('*.py'))
for path in paths:
    ast.parse(path.read_text(), filename=str(path))
print(f'Parsed {len(paths)} production Python sources')
PY
